The '''Gyndine system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Circarpous sector/Legends|Circarpous sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gyndine/Legends|Gyndine]], which was orbited by a [[Gyndine moon|moon]].<ref name="The Fear Architects" /> It was also the site of the [[Gyndine Shipyards]].<ref name="Exile" />
